settings.heading: Anatomy of an Overtake Jacket
settings.row_content: A heavyweight racing-style shell built to survive a full season, not just a few photos.

settings.heading: Fit & Sizing
settings.row_content:
Our jackets run true to size with a slightly relaxed, vintage-inspired cut. Want the oversized look? Size up.

  • S — Chest 104cm, Length 68cm, Sleeve 62cm
  • M — Chest 110cm, Length 70cm, Sleeve 64cm
  • L — Chest 116cm, Length 72cm, Sleeve 66cm
  • XL — Chest 122cm, Length 74cm, Sleeve 68cm
  • XXL — Chest 128cm, Length 76cm, Sleeve 70cm

Still unsure? Check our full Size Guide or reach out and we'll help you pick.

settings.heading: Shipping & Delivery
settings.row_content:
Every order ships in protective packaging to keep your jacket in perfect condition.

  • Processing time: 2-3 business days
  • Delivery — Europe: 10-13 business days
  • Delivery — Americas: 10-15 business days

You'll get a tracking link by email the moment your jacket ships. Full details on our Shipping Policy.

settings.heading: Vintage Look, Zero Wear
settings.row_content:
Every jacket is brand new, made to authentically capture the look and feel of classic racing paddock jackets — from the fabric weight to the embroidered patches — rather than a used or pre-owned item.

We study archive photos from the golden era of the paddock and rebuild every detail from scratch: the wash, the weight, the stitch pattern. You get the vintage look, without the vintage wear.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
Treat it right and it'll outlast a full season on the terraces.

  • Machine wash cold, gentle cycle — avoid bleach or fabric softener
  • Hang to dry or tumble dry low — avoid high heat drying
  • Wash inside out — avoid ironing directly over patches
